content:
elaine: quick postmortem follow-up from today's cross-region latency spike / TLS failures. root cause summary: LB routing map partially propagated, a subset of edge POPs routed to a backend with an expired cert. TLS handshakes failed -> retries -> client latency + 502s. below are proposed action items and tentative owners. please ack and claim what you own.

oncall-bot: Incident opened (P2) — auto-detected by edge-metrics; alerted at 2026-03-23T14:02:50Z.

natasha: ack. i'll own the immediate routing rollback and re-propagation. starting canary rollback now, will escalate to full rollback if errors persist. ETA ~45m.

natasha: command i'm running for visibility:
```bash
# list route mappings and backend cert status
routectl show --name cross-region-lb --verbose
# apply rollback policy
routectl apply --policy rollback-to-20260322
# validate propagation
routectl validate --regions all --check certs
```

mike: i’ll take backend cert rotation and add extra health-check gating to prevent serving traffic with expired certs. will open PR for automated rotation + health-check guard. ETA 4h. PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pulls/4398

sam: i’ll own alerts/recurrence. i’ll add a regional alert on tls_handshake_failures > 0.5% for 5m and create a daily postmortem-check_run for the next 2 weeks. created ticket INF-1223 and added to oncall checklist.

harpreet: adding a deploy gating step to the LB runbook — after any routing change we must run lb-smoke across all active regions and require 0 tls failures for 2m before promoting. updating /runbooks/lb-routing-verify.md and the deploy pipeline.

natasha: note: this pattern (partial propagation causing cert mismatch) looks similar to the Jan incident where the async router sync lag allowed stale configs to serve. we should add a preflight that verifies route/backends cert freshness across POPs.

elaine: ownership summary:
- natasha: routing rollback + gating, owner until stable
- mike: backend cert rotation + health-checks, owner for backend remediation
- sam: alerts, recurrence checks, INF-1223 owner
- harpreet: runbook + deploy gating changes
Target timeline: initial rollback completed within 1h, backend cert + health-checks in 4h, runbook + alerts in 48h. target close date 2026-03-25. please update INF-1223 and the incident doc with progress entries.

mike: note on health-check: adding a cert-expiry check to backend probe — snippet:
```python
# pseudo-check after backend handshake
if cert.expires_in_days < 7:
    mark_backend_unhealthy()
```

sam: added weekly recurrence for the next 6 weeks to watch for regression and scheduled a 30m sync Friday to review metrics. will add a dashboard tile for per-region retry-rate.

harpreet: PR for runbook update: github.com/redwood/runbooks/pulls/67 — will include checkout commands and the lb-smoke script.

natasha: rollback complete on canary at 14:30Z, full rollback started 14:42Z. propagation check shows 100% regions reporting expected routing map at 14:53Z. initial error rate back to baseline.

oncall-bot: Incident status -> mitigated at 2026-03-23T14:53:12Z (auto-updated).

elaine: thanks all. action owners please put progress notes in INF-1223 and mark sub-tasks done when complete. follow-up: please surface any blockers in #eng-sre if you hit propagation race conditions. :thumbsup:

natasha: acked, will follow up with a small postmortem note on the incident doc and link PRs. :eyes:
